                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Place the following in chronological order: Marshall Plan, NATO, Truman Doctrine. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The proper chronological order is Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan, NATO. In early 1947, the British told the American government that they could no longer protect Greece and Turkey from Communist threats. In gathering Congressional support to take over for the British, President Harry Truman announced what came to be known as the “Truman Doctrine” on March 12, 1947.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What foreign policy approach is George F. Kennan advocating? Why is this important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            George F. Kennan was an American diplomat with extensive experience in the Soviet Union by the mid-1940s. In his “Long Telegram” sent to Washington on February 22, 1946, and his 1947 Foreign Affairs article, initially published anonymously and signed “X,” Kennan formulated the policy of containment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Distinguish between the positions of President Harry Truman and Senator Joseph McCarthy regarding Soviet espionage in the United States. Why is this distinction important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Both President Harry Truman and Senator Joseph McCarthy believed that Soviet spies had infiltrated the American government. Revelations about Soviet spying, including in the atomic bomb program, became public in the late 1940s and early 1950s. President Truman responded to this with his Federal Employee Loyalty program, which established a Loyalty Review Board to sift security risks out of the federal bureaucracy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Place the following in chronological order: Soviet downing of a U-2 plane, Geneva Accords, Sputnik. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The proper chronological order is Geneva Accords, Sputnik, the Soviet downing of a U-2 plane. The Geneva Accords were announced on July 21, 1954. They were the result of a conference called to determine the future of Indochina. While the conference was ongoing, on May 7, the French were forced to surrender the remains of an army at Dien Bien Phu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Why is this site important for understanding the history of the cold war?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        During the 1950s, the United States began deploying Intercontinental Ballistic Missiles (ICBMs) as part of its nuclear deterrent against the Soviet Union. In the mid-1950s development began on the solid-fuel Minuteman missile. ICBMs, capable of carrying increasingly destructive nuclear warheads, were the most deadly weapons ever created.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          DAY-ITEM5s24-day-143

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What famous foreign policy theory did President Eisenhower articulate in this news conference? Why is it important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            In this news conference President Dwight D. Eisenhower articulated the “Domino Theory.” This argues that, if one country in a region falls to Communism, other neighboring countries will succumb as well, like a line of falling dominoes. This formulation is important because it became an underpinning of American involvement in Indochina in the 1950s and 1960s.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              DAY-ITEM5s24-day-144

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In the 1960s a new generation of “revisionist” historians questioned cold war orthodoxy and argued against the belief that the Soviet Union was solely responsible for the cold war, instead contending that the United States, pursuing expansive strategic and economic interests, made the dominant contribution to the onset of the struggle. A later generation of “post-revisionist” scholars challenged this interpretation and said that while both superpowers contributed to the coming of the cold war, the “revisionists” downplayed the effects of Soviet policies in precipitating conflict. Why did the disputes between historians of the cold war take on a greater significance than the usual academic debates over the past?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The disputes over the origins of the cold war took on greater significance than usual academic debates over the past because they often reflected deep political divisions. The cold war lasted over 40 years. It was still ongoing when many of these historical debates took place. The understanding of the past was thought to have relevance for present and future policy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Connect the following events with the proper year: Events: Interstate Highway Act Taft-Hartley Act Publication of On the Road Checkers Speech Fair Deal Years: 1947 1949 1952 1956 1957

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The 1947 Taft-Hartley Act was passed over President Harry Truman’s veto in a brief interval between 1947 and 1949 when the Republicans controlled Congress. The law placed some limits on union activity and required union leaders to declare that they were not Communists. Newly elected President Truman proposed an ambitious program of legislation that he called the Fair Deal in 1949.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Distinguish between the positions of President Harry Truman and South Carolina Governor Strom Thurmond on civil rights in 1948. Why is this distinction important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        In 1948, facing a strong challenge from the Republicans and New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey, President Harry Truman appealed to African American voters by proposing laws to extend greater civil rights protections to them. At the Democratic Convention, he supported a plank favoring greater civil rights for African Americans. This alienated many Southern Democrats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          DAY-ITEM5s24-day-147

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What social and economic reality is reflected in President Eisenhower’s Second Inaugural?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            President Eisenhower’s Second Inaugural reflects a widespread American prosperity in the 1950s. Prosperity began after World War II, with unemployment falling to about 4 percent in 1948. With many competitors hobbled by wartime damage, American industry dominated the world. In 1950, American industries produced 6.2 million automobiles, 6.2 million refrigerators, and 14.6 million radios.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              DAY-ITEM5s24-day-148

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In the 1998 film Pleasantville, the 1950s is presented as a time of repression, especially for African Americans and women. That women were all forced to be housewives is a widespread view of the era. Yet, by 1957 more women were working than during World War II. By 1960, 40 percent of women held jobs. Why does the less-complicated view of women’s roles in the 1950s persist? Why is this important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                One reason for the Pleasantville view of women in the 1950s is that the popular culture of the time exalted the role of woman as homemaker. Many women’s magazines, movies, and television shows persistently portrayed women as happy in the home. A good example of this would be the hit sitcom Leave It to Beaver, which first aired in 1957. Critics of this role for women helped shape the current view in the 1960s.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why were Levittown and developments like it important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    William Levitt was a developer who created seven “Levittowns” in the postwar years. His developments utilized assembly-line construction techniques perfected during World War II to quickly produce communities of largely identical homes that were comfortable and reasonably priced.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Place the following in chronological order: Montgomery Bus Boycott, Brown v. Board of Education, Little Rock Nine. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The proper chronological order is Brown v. Board of Education, Montgomery Bus Boycott, Little Rock Nine. The 1954 Brown v. Board of Education Supreme Court decision was a landmark in the African American struggle for civil rights. The Supreme Court ruled against segregation in schools by declaring that “separate but equal” was illegal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          DAY-ITEM5s24-day-151

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What is the perspective of this passage from a news report? Why is it important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The news story from the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reflects a critical attitude toward rock and roll. The new music, being popularized by bands like Bill Haley and his Comets, is seen as encouraging violent behavior. Many adults in the 1950s believed that rock and roll was “devil’s music,” and associated it with immorality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Connect the following events with the proper year: Events: Bay of Pigs Sit-ins begin Assassination of President John F. Kennedy Cuban Missile Crisis Gulf of Tonkin Resolution Years: 1960 1961 1962 1963 1964

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Sit-ins as a tactic for civil rights protesters began in 1960. African American students staged a sit-in at a segregated lunch counter at a Greensboro, North Carolina, Woolworth store. In an attempt to overthrow the Communist regime of Fidel Castro in Cuba, the United States landed a force of anti-Castro Cubans at the Bay of Pigs in Cuba on April 17, 1961.
