                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What is the perspective of Senator Goldwater? Why is it important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona won the Republican nomination for president in 1964. Goldwater was a conservative who rejected the political legacy of the New Deal. He called for a return to limited government and promised a more robust military and diplomatic response to Communist aggression. In the general election Goldwater was heavily defeated by President Lyndon B.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      DAY-ITEM5s24-day-155

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Distinguish between “Old Left” and “New Left.” Why is this distinction important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The “Old Left” was associated with loyalty to the Communist Party and an approach to politics that emphasized ideological discipline and a hierarchical organization. The young founders of the “New Left” rejected this approach. They stressed “participatory democracy” and individual control of one’s life.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          DAY-ITEM5s24-day-156

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Place the following in chronological order: Tet Offensive, Woodstock Music Festival, Medicare. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The proper chronological order is Medicare, Tet Offensive, and Woodstock Music Festival. Medicare was passed in 1965 as part of President Lyndon B. Johnson’s Great Society. Medicare is a federal program that provides medical insurance to Americans aged 65 and older. The Tet Offensive was a massive series of Communist attacks that were launched all across South Vietnam beginning on January 30, 1968.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              DAY-ITEM5s24-day-157

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What is the perspective of President Johnson in this passage? Why is it important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In this passage, President Lyndon B. Johnson is defending American involvement in Vietnam. At this point, the United States was supporting South Vietnam against an insurgency being waged by Viet Cong guerillas and soldiers from North Vietnam. In March, Johnson had sent a contingent of Marines into Vietnam to protect the American airbase at Danang.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  DAY-ITEM5s24-day-158

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How does the memorial capture Americans’ complex feelings about the Vietnam War?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The Vietnam Veterans Memorial was designed by a young artist named Maya Lin and was dedicated on November 13, 1982. The design, two long black walls etched with the names of the 58,000 Americans who lost their lives in the Vietnam War, was controversial because some critics thought it was too modest and somber and did not celebrate the achievements of the memorialized servicemen and women.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Connect the following events with the proper year: Events: Fall of South Vietnam Resignation of President Richard Nixon Iran Hostage Crisis begins Roe v. Wade Camp David Accords Years: 1973 1974 1975 1978 1979

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The 1973 Roe v. Wade Supreme Court decision argued that women had a right to an abortion before fetal viability. This set off a long-standing political battle over abortion. President Richard M. Nixon resigned on August 9, 1974. He was in danger of being impeached for obstruction of justice in the Watergate scandal, and his political situation had become untenable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Distinguish between the foreign policy approach of President Richard M. Nixon and his predecessors. Why is this distinction important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            President Richard M. Nixon was innovative in his foreign policy initiatives. He launched a new phase of the Vietnam War with his policy of “Vietnamization,” which consisted of turning more of the fighting over to the South Vietnamese while gradually pulling out American troops. Nixon supported the South Vietnamese with training, supplies, and a massive bombing campaign.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              DAY-ITEM5s24-day-163

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What problem is President Carter referring to in this passage? Why is this important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                President Jimmy Carter was referring to the energy crisis of the 1970s. The world faced shortages of oil as a result of the Arab Oil Embargo in the aftermath of the 1973 Yom Kippur War and the 1979 Iranian Revolution. In 1973 American drivers for a time had to submit to gas rationing. In 1974, Congress passed a law setting the national speed limit at 55 miles per hour.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Place the following in chronological order: Tax Reform Act, Strategic Defense Initiative, INF Treaty. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The proper chronological order is Strategic Defense Initiative, Tax Reform Act, and INF Treaty. Under President Ronald Reagan Cold War tensions intensified as he accelerated an arms buildup begun under President Jimmy Carter. Reagan also ramped up rhetorical attacks on the Soviet dictatorship.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      DAY-ITEM5s24-day-165

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What perspective on government does President Reagan express in this passage? Why is this important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        President Ronald Reagan believed that prosperity came from Americans pursuing their economic goals as freely as possible from government intervention. To encourage this, Reagan attempted to cut the size of government and turn some services back to the states with his plan for a New Federalism. He also cut tax rates and promoted the policy of deregulation in the energy and transportation industries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          DAY-ITEM5s24-day-167

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Connect the following events with the proper year: Events: Fall of the Berlin Wall Operation Desert Shield Fall of the Soviet Union Passage of NAFTA Election of Bill Clinton Years: 1989 1990 1991 1992 1993

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The Berlin Wall was broken down in 1989 as the Soviet Union weakened and the people of Eastern Europe began to overthrow their Soviet-imposed Communist governments. Operation Desert Shield was implemented by President George Herbert Walker Bush to protect Saudi Arabia after Iraq invaded and conquered Kuwait in August 1990.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              DAY-ITEM5s24-day-168

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              President Bush in the passage above expressed the euphoria at the end of the cold war. Americans began to expect a “peace dividend” in the form of decreased defense spending. The scholar Francis Fukuyama published a widely discussed book entitled The End of History and the Last Man (1992) in which he argued that with the demise of Communism, humanity had reached the end of its ideological evolution, and the world would gradually adopt Western liberal democracy. Was Fukuyama’s prediction of an end of ideological struggle borne out by events?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The end of the Cold War was a watershed event. The American people wanted to enjoy their “peace dividend” and move in new directions. In the election of 1992, President George Herbert Walker Bush was replaced by the much younger William Jefferson (Bill) Clinton. While scholars debated Francis Fukuyama’s thesis on the “end of history,” most Americans enjoyed the prosperity of the 1990s.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  DAY-ITEM5s24-day-170

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Place the following in chronological order: Kosovo War, Contract with America, Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act. Why are these important?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The proper chronological order is Contract with America, Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act, Kosovo War. The 1994 Contract with America was written by Republican congressmen Newt Gingrich and Dick Armey. It was signed by almost all Republican congressional candidates and laid out a detailed platform of objectives, including welfare reform and tax cuts.
