                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The jury's acquittal of Zenger demonstrated that colonial juries could

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A Levy taxes on the colonists
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B Declare independence from Britain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C Enforce the Navigation Acts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D Serve as a check on royal authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The acquittal showed a colonial jury defying the royal governor's handpicked judges — the jury as a popular check on imperial authority. Juries levied no taxes, declared no independence, and enforced no trade acts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Colonial juries did not levy taxes — taxation was the assembly's and Parliament's business, not the jury's.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: The jury did not declare independence — that came forty years later. The acquittal was a check on the governor, not a revolution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: The jury did not enforce the Navigation Acts — those were enforced by vice-admiralty courts, often against colonial wishes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Correct. The acquittal showed a colonial jury defying the royal governor's handpicked judges — the jury serving as a popular check on imperial authority.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • major · answer_tell — keyed answer is uniquely and substantially longest
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-21

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A historian using Ferraro's self-description as evidence about the Democrats' 1984 campaign strategy should conclude that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A It proves the Democratic Party had become the party of the working class in actual policy, not just in campaign rhetoric
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B It shows how the campaign wanted voters to see her -- upward mobility embodied -- rather than a neutral biography
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C It is useless as evidence because candidates always exaggerate their backgrounds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D It was aimed mainly at winning Republican voters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  An acceptance speech is crafted for a purpose -- to introduce the candidate on the campaign's terms. Ferraro's self-portrait as the daughter of working Americans tells a historian how the 1984 Democratic campaign wanted voters to see her: the embodiment of upward mobility. It is evidence of the campaign's framing strategy, not a neutral biography and not a policy platform.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: The speech shows how the campaign wanted to be seen, not what the party would do in office. A self-portrait in an acceptance address is evidence of campaign framing -- it cannot prove what the party's actual policies became.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Correct. Ferraro's self-description -- daughter of working Americans, child of an immigrant father -- is the campaign's chosen frame: upward mobility embodied. It shows how the Democrats wanted her understood, not a neutral record of her life.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: A source being crafted for a purpose does not make it useless. The whole point of sourcing analysis is to ask what a strategic source reveals -- here, how the Democrats framed their ticket in 1984. 'Candidates always lie' would rule out almost every campaign document historians use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: An acceptance speech is delivered to the party's own convention -- its first audience is fellow Democrats, not Republicans. The goal was to energize the Democratic base and introduce Ferraro to the nation, not to convert Republicans.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • minor · answer_tell — only one distractor uses absolute wording
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-23

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ferraro's candidacy faced sustained attacks centered on

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A Her support for Prohibition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B Her Civil War military record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C Her family's finances and tax disclosures
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D Her opposition to woman suffrage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Questions about her husband John Zaccaro's real-estate dealings and the couple's tax returns dogged Ferraro for weeks in 1984. Prohibition, the Civil War, and suffrage had nothing to do with her campaign.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Prohibition was long dead by 1984 — Ferraro's campaign had nothing to do with it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Ferraro had no Civil War military record — she was a 20th-century congresswoman. The question is about her 1984 campaign.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: Correct. Questions about her husband John Zaccaro's real-estate dealings and the couple's tax returns dogged Ferraro for weeks in 1984.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Ferraro did not oppose woman suffrage — she was its beneficiary, the first woman on a major-party national ticket. Opposition to suffrage was the opposite of her position.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ferraro's barrier-breaking role is most directly comparable to

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A Abigail Adams's letters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B Clara Barton's nursing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C Phyllis Schlafly's activism
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D Shirley Chisholm's 1972 run for the Democratic presidential nomination
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Chisholm's 1972 campaign for the Democratic presidential nomination broke the same kind of national-ticket barrier Ferraro broke twelve years later. Adams wrote letters, Barton nursed soldiers, and Schlafly organized against the ERA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Abigail Adams's letters were private correspondence, not a barrier-breaking national candidacy. Her role was different in kind from Ferraro's.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Clara Barton's nursing was humanitarian service, not a national political candidacy. Her barrier-breaking was in a different field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: Phyllis Schlafly's activism opposed the ERA — she organized against the feminist movement Ferraro represented. Schlafly was the opposition, not the parallel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Correct. Shirley Chisholm's 1972 campaign for the Democratic presidential nomination broke the same kind of national-ticket barrier Ferraro broke twelve years later.
