                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Jefferson's 'Revolution of 1800' reversed Federalist policies by

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A Expanding the navy and raising tariffs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B Creating a new national bank
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C Reducing the army, cutting taxes, and paying down the debt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D Declaring war on France
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The 'Revolution of 1800' was a policy revolution: Jefferson shrank the army and navy, repealed internal taxes, and attacked the national debt. He built no new bank, raised no tariffs, and made no war on France.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Jefferson did not expand the navy or raise tariffs — he shrank the military and repealed internal taxes. Expansion was the opposite of his program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Jefferson did not create a new national bank — he opposed the Bank of the United States and let its influence wane. A new bank was never his policy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: Correct. The 'Revolution of 1800' was a policy revolution: Jefferson shrank the army and navy, repealed internal taxes, and attacked the national debt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Jefferson did not declare war on France — he pursued peace and bought Louisiana from Napoleon. War with France was never his policy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • major · answer_tell — keyed answer is uniquely and substantially longest
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-52

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Adams's depiction of Washington as a cultural backwater illustrates

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A How new and unformed the national government still was
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B British cultural superiority over America
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C The city's rapid industrialization
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D Southern economic dominance of the nation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Adams's village-capital — politicians 'living like bears' without court or commerce — shows a national government still inventing itself from nothing. It illustrates newness, not British superiority, industry, or Southern dominance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Correct. Adams's village-capital — politicians 'living like bears' without court or commerce — shows a national government still inventing itself from nothing, new and unformed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Adams does not argue British cultural superiority — his point is about the newness of the American government, not about Britain's advantages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: Washington was not industrializing — Adams depicts a muddy village, not factories. Industrialization is the opposite of his image.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Adams does not depict Southern economic dominance — his subject is the unformed national capital, not sectional economics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • major · answer_tell — keyed answer is uniquely and substantially longest
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-53

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Roosevelt addressed the ACLU in March 1940 because

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A She supported the internment of Japanese Americans
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B She feared war would again erode civil liberties as in World War I
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C The ACLU had opposed the New Deal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D The Cold War had already begun
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Roosevelt spoke to the ACLU as Europe went to war because she feared a repeat of 1917–18, when dissent was criminalized — the motive for her warning. She never supported internment, the ACLU backed civil liberties, and the Cold War had not begun.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Roosevelt never supported the internment of Japanese Americans — she was one of the administration's internal critics of it. Support was the opposite of her position.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: Correct. Roosevelt spoke to the ACLU as Europe went to war because she feared a repeat of 1917–18, when dissent was criminalized — the motive for her warning that Americans must guard civil liberties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: The ACLU did not oppose the New Deal — it was a civil-liberties organization, and Roosevelt addressed it on liberties, not on New Deal politics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: The Cold War had not begun in March 1940 — it started after World War II. Roosevelt's concern was a repeat of World War I's repression.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • major · answer_tell — keyed answer is uniquely and substantially longest
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MCQ5s24-exam2-mcq-55

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Like Roosevelt in 1940, critics of the Patriot Act argued that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. A Both groups sought to abolish presidential wartime powers entirely
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. B No comparison is possible because Roosevelt faced a genuine threat while the terrorism threat was invented as a pretext
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. C Both groups argued that constitutions should be suspended until each crisis had passed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. D National crises tempt governments to trade liberty for security
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Roosevelt warned in 1940 that wartime nations lose freedoms of press, speech, and assembly, and that Americans at peace must guard them. The Patriot Act's critics made the same argument about post-9/11 surveillance and detention: crisis tempts even free governments to trade liberty for security.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A: Neither side wanted to abolish presidential wartime powers entirely. Roosevelt warned liberties must be guarded during crises -- she never said wartime authority itself must be eliminated -- and the Patriot Act's critics targeted specific provisions, not the very existence of wartime powers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • B: This judges which threat was 'real' instead of answering what the two sides argued. Roosevelt's and the critics' shared claim was about how governments respond to fear -- the argument is the same regardless of the threat. Dismissing the comparison by relitigating the threats misses both sides' point.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • C: This is backwards. Both sides argued the opposite of suspending constitutions: that liberties must be defended precisely when crisis makes abandoning them tempting. Neither called for suspension.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D: Correct. Roosevelt warned that democracy is endangered whenever the light of liberty grows dim and that wartime nations surrender freedoms of press, speech, and assembly; the Patriot Act's critics argued post-9/11 fear was producing the same bargain -- liberty traded for security.
