                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch07-q04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Stamp Act Congress of 1765 was historically significant in that it

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A represented a first step in colonial unity against Britain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B demonstrated Parliament’s determination to tax its American colonies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C represented New England’s determination to go to war against England
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D demonstrated the colonists’ political and philosophical disagreement among themselves
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Stamp Act Congress was a gathering of representatives from several colonies to address the newly enacted Stamp Act. This represented the first (of several) Continental Congress meetings to address British taxation practices. The Stamp Act Congress of 1765 is historically significant because it marked the beginning of colonial unity and resistance against the British, so (A) is the correct answer. Eliminate (B), as the Stamp Act of 1765 was a reaction to the Parliament’s determination to tax the American Colonies without representation. One could argue that most colonists still considered themselves to be loyal British subjects even after fighting had begun in Lexington and Concord in April 1775, so eliminate (C) as well. Finally, (D) most likely refers to the Albany Plan of Union, proposed by Benjamin Franklin at the start of the French and Indian War, which was rejected by colonists in favor of maintaining individual colonial sovereignty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Nine colonies sent delegates to New York in 1765 to coordinate petitions and boycotts against the Stamp Act — the first joint political action by the colonies against Britain, and the start of intercolonial unity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The Stamp Act itself demonstrated Parliament's determination to tax the colonies. The Congress demonstrated the opposite: colonial resistance, not Parliament's will.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: In 1765 New England was not determined to go to war; most colonists still considered themselves loyal British subjects. War was still a decade away.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The Congress produced unified petitions and a coordinated boycott — a show of agreement across colonies, not of philosophical disagreement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch07-q06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Historians often cite Shays’s Rebellion (1786–1787) as a significant event in U.S. history because it

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A demonstrated the strength, yet fairness, of the newly created federal government
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B made many Americans realize that slavery could not last
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C made Americans realize that excessive taxation often leads to violence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D demonstrated the weakness of the federal government under the Articles of Confederation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Articles of Confederation had intentionally created a weak central government, granting Congress few regulatory powers to avoid creating an American Parliament. Shays’s Rebellion threatened the survival of the newly established republic because farmers in western Massachusetts were rebelling against their state government for the very same reason colonists had rebelled against England—taxes. Under the Articles of Confederation, Congress could neither raise nor support a federal militia, so when Massachusetts requested federal assistance in squelching Daniel Shays and his farmer friends, no help was available. Had this question been about the Whiskey Rebellion during George Washington’s administration, (A) would have been the correct answer. Choice (A) also demonstrates the difference between the limited power of the federal government under the Articles of Confederation and the stronger federal government established by the Constitution. Choice (C) is not correct, although excessive taxation was certainly one of the major causes of the American Revolution and subsequent rebellions. It is interesting to note that we did not have a federal income tax until the Sixteenth Amendment was ratified in the early 20th century.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Shays's Rebellion exposed weakness, not strength. It happened in 1786-87, under the Articles of Confederation — the new federal government under the Constitution did not yet exist.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Slavery was not at issue in Shays's Rebellion. Massachusetts farmers rose against state taxes and debt foreclosures, not over slavery.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Excessive taxation did anger the farmers, but historians cite the rebellion's significance differently: it proved the national government under the Articles was too weak to keep order, which pushed leaders toward the Constitutional Convention.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Congress under the Articles could neither levy taxes nor raise a federal force, so Massachusetts had to suppress Daniel Shays's uprising on its own. The episode demonstrated the Articles' weakness and helped trigger the 1787 Constitutional Convention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch07-q07

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Under the Articles of Confederation, the national government had which of the following powers? The power to collect taxes The power to negotiate treaties The power to supersede state law

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A I only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B II only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C I and III only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D I, II, and III
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Articles of Confederation were established to provide a limited framework to organize the states under a single banner. However, they had very little power (purposefully) so that each state could create its own government and legislation. States were expected to establish taxation, while Congress was not authorized to enact taxes under the Articles of Confederation (eliminating I). Furthermore, the whole purpose of the Articles of Confederation was to provide a legal document to enforce states’ rights, not undermine them (eliminating III). The Articles of Confederation did, however, provide a framework for how the United States government would represent the states in foreign diplomatic matters such as treaties (making II correct).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Incorrect — tax collection was power I, which Congress did not have. Under the Articles, Congress could only request money from the states, not levy taxes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Correct — treaty negotiation was power II, which Congress did have (it negotiated the 1783 Treaty of Paris ending the Revolution). Powers I (taxes) and III (overriding state law) were deliberately withheld.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Incorrect — it pairs power I (taxes), which Congress lacked, with power III (superseding state law), which the Articles never granted. The whole point of the Articles was to protect state sovereignty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Incorrect — Congress had only power II. It could not tax (I) and it could not override state law (III); there was no supremacy clause under the Articles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Which of the following best fits the profile of a Democratic-Republican?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A A wealthy merchant from New York who desires a strict interpretation of the Constitution
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B A zealous supporter of the National Bank
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C A yeoman farmer from South Carolina whose sympathies lie with France
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D An advocate for centralized power and a strong alliance with England
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Democratic-Republicans, who favored state power and a strict interpretation of the Constitution, tended to be southern yeoman farmers who desired an economy based on agriculture and a strong alliance with France. They viewed the establishment of a National Bank as desirable but not critical. In contrast, the federalists, who favored a powerful central government and a loose interpretation of the Constitution, tended to be wealthy northeasterners who desired an economy based on commerce and a close alliance with England. They wholeheartedly approved of a National Bank, which they deemed essential to successful governance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: This profile is internally contradictory: wealthy merchants backed the Federalists, who favored a loose (not strict) interpretation of the Constitution and a strong central government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Zealous support for the National Bank was the Federalist (Hamiltonian) position. Democratic-Republicans were skeptical of the Bank as an overreach of federal power.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Democratic-Republicans were Jefferson's party: southern and western yeoman farmers who favored agriculture, states' rights, strict construction of the Constitution, and sympathy with revolutionary France against Britain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Centralized power and a close alliance with England describe the Federalists, the Democratic-Republicans' opponents.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch07-q11

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              All of the following were immediate social or economic consequences of the American Revolution EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A increased opportunities for land settlement in the West
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B reform of primogeniture inheritance laws
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C expanded rights for women to hold property
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D the opening of many areas of trade and manufacture
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First, cross out “EXCEPT” from the question and determine whether each answer is true or false based on the question stem. The American Revolution Era in the late 1700s was when the colonies broke from Great Britain, and the main disputes were taxing and trading laws. Most people lived on the Atlantic coast. Choices (A) and (D) are firmly within the American Revolution, so they’re both true. Remember that this is an EXCEPT question, so if an answer choice is true, eliminate it! Maybe you’re not sure between (B) and (C), so which of these things is least like the others? That would be (C), expanded rights for women to hold property. Women’s rights did not become an issue until decades later, in the mid-1800s, with the Seneca Falls convention and the first women’s rights movement. Choice (C) is then false, which makes it the correct answer for this EXCEPT question.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Western land settlement did expand as an immediate consequence of independence — the end of British restrictions and then the Northwest Ordinance (1787) opened new opportunities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Several states did reform inheritance law right after independence, abolishing primogeniture and entail (Virginia did so in 1776) — a genuine immediate consequence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Women's property rights did not expand after the Revolution. Under coverture, married women's legal identity remained subsumed in their husbands', and women's legal status was essentially unchanged.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Independence ended the Navigation Acts, opening American merchants and manufacturers to new markets — a genuine immediate economic consequence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings
