                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q02

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Louisiana Purchase was an important factor in the development of U.S. trade because it

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A opened new markets among the western Indian nations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B gave the country complete control of the Mississippi River
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C added numerous French factories in the Louisiana Territory to the U.S. economy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D facilitated the immediate completion of the transcontinental railroad
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Louisiana Purchase grew out of the government’s efforts to purchase New Orleans from the French. President Jefferson wanted control of the city because it sits at the mouth of the Mississippi River, an essential trade route. Jefferson sent James Monroe to France to negotiate the sale. The French, desperate for cash and nearly as desperate to divest themselves of New World holdings, offered to sell the entire massive Louisiana Territory. The United States would control both banks of the Mississippi River, as well as a tremendous amount of western land. As a result, American traders could travel the length of the river unimpeded and trade subsequently boomed. Many of the incorrect answers to this question are anachronistic; the date of the purchase was too early for there to be “numerous French factories” in the territory, as in (C), or to allow for “the immediate completion of the transcontinental railroad,” as in (D).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: New markets among western Indian nations were not the trade significance of the purchase. Jefferson wanted New Orleans and the Mississippi — the artery for American commerce.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The purchase gave the United States both banks of the Mississippi River plus New Orleans at its mouth, securing complete American control of the essential trade route to the Gulf.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: French trading posts were not the point of the purchase. The value was the Mississippi, the port of New Orleans, and the vast western land — not French industrial assets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The transcontinental railroad was not completed until 1869, more than six decades later. It belongs to a much later era and had nothing to do with the 1803 purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q03

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              As a result of the Hartford Convention following the War of 1812,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A the Federalist Party lost credibility and eventually died out
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B the Constitution was amended to limit the president to two terms in office
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C the New England states threatened to secede
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D Congress passed the War Powers Act, limiting future presidents from gaining too much power during wartime, as Madison had
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The War of 1812 was very unpopular with New England Federalists who called the war “Mr. Madison’s War.” The economic policies of Jefferson and Madison disrupted trade, and as a result, were detrimental to New England merchants and shippers. Consequently, a group of New England Federalists met in Hartford, Connecticut, in 1814 to articulate a list of grievances against the Democratic-Republicans and their policies. While some men suggested secession, others suggested amending the Constitution to protect New England’s commercial interests against what they perceived to be a dangerous, growing threat from the agrarian, Republican South. Because the British were “defeated” in the War of 1812, what is often termed the Second War for Independence, the Federalists were seen as big babies and discredited. With the election of James Monroe in 1816, the United States had entered the Era of Good Feelings, a relatively brief period when there was only one political party—the Republicans. Although the War of 1812 damaged New England commerce initially, in the long run, the Embargo Act of 1807 and the War of 1812 forced Americans to be less dependent on British goods and indirectly stimulated the growth of industry in antebellum New England.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: New England Federalists met at Hartford in 1814 to air grievances while the war was still on, which looked unpatriotic. When the war ended and Jackson triumphed at New Orleans, the party was discredited and soon disappeared.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: No constitutional amendment limiting presidents to two terms came out of Hartford. The two-term limit remained custom until the 22nd Amendment in 1951.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Although a few delegates talked of secession, the convention itself issued grievances and proposed constitutional amendments — it did not threaten secession.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: No War Powers Act was passed in this era; the War Powers Act dates to 1973. Madison's wartime power was not curtailed by any such law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The controversy over the tariff during the late 1820s and early 1830s demonstrated that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A New Englanders were more radical than Southerners, as they had been since the days of the American Revolution
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B Andrew Jackson favored states’ rights over federal supremacy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C the system of checks and balances was flawed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D economic sectionalism was a serious threat to national unity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The tariff in question here is the infamous Tariff of Abominations, so named by southern states which protested that this protective tariff benefited New England manufacturers at the expense of cotton exporters in the South. The enactment of the Tariff of 1828 led to the Nullification Crisis a few years later when South Carolina declared the tariff null and void. (A similar situation had occurred in 1798 when Jefferson and Madison penned the Virginia and Kentucky resolutions in protest against the Alien and Sedition Acts.) In the case of Marbury v. Madison , Marshall opined that only the Supreme Court, not individual states, could rule a law to be unconstitutional. Eventually, a compromise tariff was brokered, and the crisis was resolved. Nevertheless, the Nullification Crisis during Andrew Jackson’s administration exposed the increasing tension of economic sectionalism that would propel the nation to civil war 30 years later.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: This reverses the actual alignment. The radicals in the tariff fight were Southerners — South Carolina nullified the tariff — while New England manufacturers benefited from the protection.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: In the Nullification Crisis Jackson defended federal supremacy, not states' rights: he pushed the Force Bill through Congress and threatened military action against South Carolina.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The crisis did not expose a flaw in checks and balances. The constitutional system worked — the dispute was settled politically with the Compromise Tariff of 1833.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The Tariff of Abominations (1828) protected Northern manufacturers at the expense of Southern cotton exporters, and South Carolina's nullification response showed how economic sectionalism could threaten national unity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Andrew Jackson’s positions on the Second National Bank and the American System typified his

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A distrust of large national government programs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B abhorrence of the spoils system
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C tendency to favor the interests of the Northeast
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D commitment to developing a national economy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Andrew Jackson generally sided with the states on the issue of states’ rights, preferring to limit the powers of the federal government to only those he perceived to be essential. He also favored his Western constituency to the power elite of the Northeast, whom he regarded with suspicion. Thus, Jackson vetoed the recharter of the Second National Bank, a large federal program championed by Northeastern bankers, and opposed federally funded internal improvements under Clay’s American System.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Jackson vetoed the recharter of the Second National Bank and opposed federally funded internal improvements. Both stances reflect his suspicion of large national programs and of the Northeastern elite behind them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Jackson did not abhor the spoils system — he embraced it, defending 'rotation in office' as democratic reform when he replaced federal officeholders with his own supporters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Jackson distrusted the Northeast's power elite; his political base was in the South and West. Favoring Northeastern interests is the opposite of his profile.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Building up a national economy through federal programs was Henry Clay's American System, which Jackson opposed — not Jackson's own program.
