                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q07

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Cherokee of Georgia were forced off their land because

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A they refused to assimilate to the “American” way of life
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B gold was discovered on Cherokee land in Georgia
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C the Supreme Court refused to hear their cases
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D the Seminole tribe, their traditional enemy, conquered their territory
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Cherokee were considered part of the “Five Civilized Tribes” living in the South, having established a republic in the state of Georgia. Unfortunately, the discovery of gold within the Cherokee nation’s borders was the catalyst for the tribe’s forced relocation. Georgian citizens wanted to enforce the Indian Removal Act in order to have access to the territory. Although the Supreme Court ruled in favor of the Cherokees, President Andrew Jackson did not comply with the decision. States’ rights were an important issue during Jackson’s presidency, and he did not want to intervene on behalf of the Cherokee nation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: The Cherokee had assimilated to a remarkable degree — a written constitution, a republican government, a newspaper — as one of the 'Five Civilized Tribes.' Assimilation did not save them from removal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Gold was discovered on Cherokee land in Georgia in 1828-29, and the resulting land rush created overwhelming pressure to seize Cherokee territory and enforce removal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The Supreme Court did hear the Cherokees' cases and ruled in their favor, notably in Worcester v. Georgia (1832). President Jackson simply refused to enforce the decision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The Seminole did not conquer Cherokee territory. The Seminole lived in Florida and fought their own separate war against removal; they were not the cause of Cherokee dispossession.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q09

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Which of the following statements was NOT consistent with the foreign policy of the Monroe Doctrine?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A The United States had authority to intervene in the affairs of other nations in the Western hemisphere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B The United States would not interfere in the affairs of European powers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C European nations were not permitted to trade with nations of the Western hemisphere without U.S. consent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D European nations should stay out of the affairs of the Western hemisphere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Monroe Doctrine aimed to establish a policy of mutual noninterference with European governments. While largely unenforceable by the United States, it established that the United States would stay out of European affairs if Europe stayed out of affairs of the Western Hemisphere. While trade and diplomacy would still occur between Europe and the Americas, this foreign policy would aid in keeping the United States out of European conflicts during the 19th century.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: The Doctrine asserted a U.S. sphere of influence in the Western Hemisphere, positioning the United States as its protector — consistent with claiming authority over hemispheric affairs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Non-interference in European affairs was one half of the Doctrine's bargain: the United States would stay out of Europe's quarrels if Europe stayed out of the Americas.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The Monroe Doctrine never restricted European trade with the Americas. It opposed new European colonization and intervention in American governments; commerce and diplomacy across the Atlantic continued.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Warning European powers to stay out of the affairs of the Western Hemisphere is the core of the Monroe Doctrine — fully consistent with it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch08-q11

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              All of the following are true of the temperance movement in the United States EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A it originated largely through the efforts of German and Irish immigrant women
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B it was inspired by The Second Great Awakening
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C its ultimate success through the enactment of the 18th Amendment was facilitated by the fact that women’s suffrage was imminent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D it was predominantly led by the middle and upper classes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The American temperance movement was originated and led by protestant women of the middle and upper classes who were inspired by the religious fervor of the Second Great Awakening. Largely a female-driven movement, its culmination in the 18th Amendment occurred just as women were being granted the right to vote. However, German and Irish immigrants (both male and female), many of whom were Catholic, tended to oppose the temperance movement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: German and Irish immigrants, many of them Catholic, generally opposed temperance rather than leading it. The movement was founded and led by Protestant women of the middle and upper classes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The temperance movement drew directly on the moral-reform energy of the Second Great Awakening, which mobilized Protestants against drinking as a social sin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The 18th Amendment (1919) was ratified just as women's suffrage was about to be secured (19th Amendment, 1920), and the prospect of women voters helped carry prohibition over the finish line.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Temperance was predominantly a middle- and upper-class movement, led by respectable Protestant women — not a working-class or immigrant cause.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q02

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Keynesian economic theory would assert that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A government interference in economics for the purpose of remedying a depression will only make matters worse
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B the way to avoid an economic depression is for people to start saving a high percentage of their incomes as soon as the economy takes a downturn
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C economic depressions worsen when individuals buy what they cannot comfortably afford
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D lavish spending during an economic depression should be encouraged
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Economist John Maynard Keynes theorized that a depression is the result of a vicious cycle: an economic downturn causes people to become anxious and reluctant to spend money, which leads businesses to fail and the economy to worsen, which leads to even greater anxiety and reluctance to spend money, which exacerbates the economic situation, etc. The way to stop the cycle and improve the economy is, perhaps counterintuitively, for people to spend money freely during times of hardship. The government can facilitate this process by providing its citizens with funds, whether through jobs or handouts, which they will presumably spend and thereby stimulate the economy. Roosevelt’s policies during the Great Depression were based on Keynesian economics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: That is the classical laissez-faire view Keynes argued against. Keynes held that government must intervene in a depression, not stand aside.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Keynes argued the opposite: when everyone saves during a downturn, demand collapses further (the paradox of thrift). Spending, not saving, breaks the cycle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Keynes did not moralize about consumers buying what they cannot afford. His theory is about total (aggregate) demand in the economy, not about personal spending virtue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Keynes theorized that depressions feed on collapsing demand: fear makes people stop spending, businesses fail, and the spiral deepens. The cure is spending — including lavish government spending, even at a deficit — to restore demand.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q03

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Following the Spanish–American War and the acquisition of territory overseas, in a series of cases known as the Insular Cases, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A natives living on American soil abroad were guaranteed the same rights and privileges as U.S. citizens living within the continental United States
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B colonial subjects within the American Empire were not entitled to the rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C “the Constitution follows the flag”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D Congress must relinquish control of these overseas possessions and honor their right of self-determination
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              As a result of winning the Spanish–American War in 1898, the United States acquired Guam, Puerto Rico, the Philippines, and for all intents and purposes, Cuba. (Although we had claimed we had no interest in acquiring Cuba and could empathize with its colonial status, having once been a colony ourselves, the Platt Amendment rendered the island a virtual colony of the United States.) The situation in the Philippines created intense debate between business interests that saw the enormous economic benefits to acquiring “stepping stones” to profitable Chinese trade, and those Americans who believed having colonies contradicted our fundamental democratic principles. Once we acquired overseas possessions, a question arose as to the rights and privileges of the Native peoples living within the American Empire. In a series of Supreme Court cases known as the Insular Cases, the Court ruled that the “Constitution did not follow the flag,” and thus, colonial subjects were not entitled to the same rights as U.S. citizens living at home or abroad.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: The Court ruled the opposite: people in the newly acquired territories were not guaranteed the same constitutional rights as residents of the states.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: In the Insular Cases (1901) the Court held that the Constitution does not fully apply to 'unincorporated' territories like Puerto Rico and the Philippines, so colonial subjects were not entitled to full constitutional rights.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: 'The Constitution follows the flag' was the argument the Court rejected. The Insular Cases held that it does not automatically follow American sovereignty overseas.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The Court did not order Congress to give up the possessions or grant them self-determination. It upheld continued American control while withholding full constitutional protections.
