                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q04

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Which of the following best summarizes the contents of the Zimmermann telegram, which was intercepted in 1917?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A Germany offered Mexico an alliance and help regaining land lost in the Mexican Cession if Mexico attacked the United States
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B A British spy alerted the world to the existence of mass extermination camps in German-held territories.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C The United States assured the British that it would join the war in Europe if the war were to continue for another year.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D The owner of the Boston Red Sox revealed a plan to sell star player Babe Ruth to the New York Yankees for a large amount of cash.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              This is a straight recall question. You either know what the Zimmermann telegram is or you don’t. If you know it, you’re going to get this question right. If you don’t, use Process of Elimination to get rid of anachronistic answers, as in (B), or answers that seem un-AP-like because they don’t reinforce important themes of U.S. history, as in (D). You should know, however, that the Zimmermann telegram was one of the reasons the United States entered World War I.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: In the intercepted 1917 telegram, German foreign minister Zimmermann offered Mexico a military alliance: if the United States entered World War I, Mexico should attack it and would be rewarded with the territory lost in the 1848 Mexican Cession (Texas, New Mexico, Arizona). Its publication helped push the U.S. into the war.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Mass extermination camps belong to World War II and the Holocaust, not to World War I. This is anachronistic by a generation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The telegram ran the other way: it was from Germany to Mexico, intercepted and decoded by the British. It contained no American assurance to Britain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Babe Ruth's sale to the Yankees (1919-20) is baseball history, unrelated to World War I diplomacy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Wilson’s Fourteen Points plan for peace after World War I included all of the following EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A promotion of universal self-determination
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B lower tariffs to promote free trade
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C repayment of all Allied war expenses by Germany
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D across-the-board arms reductions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In the aftermath of World War I, President Wilson favored a peace that would promote openness in international affairs, free trade, and diplomacy. He also sought universal arms reductions and a mechanism for enforcing world peace, which was to be achieved through the League of Nations. He did not seek a punitive treaty that forced Germany to pay heavy reparations; the European allies, however, insisted. Wilson was able to negotiate very little of his Fourteen Points plan, but he remained optimistic that the League of Nations would eventually broker a fairer postwar peace. Unfortunately, Wilson’s hopes were never realized.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Universal self-determination for peoples was central to the Fourteen Points — not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: Removing trade barriers and lowering tariffs was part of Wilson's vision of free trade — not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Wilson did not want a punitive peace. He opposed forcing Germany to pay heavy reparations; the European Allies imposed them anyway in the Treaty of Versailles.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Across-the-board arms reductions were part of the Fourteen Points — not the exception.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q07

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              All of the following can be seen as clashes between traditional and modern culture during the Post–World War I Era EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A the rise of the Ku Klux Klan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B the Teapot Dome Scandal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C the Scopes Monkey Trial
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D the Emergency Quota Act
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Ku Klux Klan evoked the execrable southern traditions of racism and physical intimidation against the modern drive for expanded civil rights. The Scopes Monkey Trial pitted religion against the modern notion of evolution. The Emergency Quota Act was passed to check immigration from non-western European countries; its champions felt the nation’s Western European traditions were threatened by immigrants from Southern Europe, Eastern Europe, South America, and Asia. The Teapot Dome Scandal, on the other hand, was just an example of good old-fashioned political corruption.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: The 1920s Klan revival fused old-style racism and intimidation with resistance to the modern expansion of civil rights — a genuine traditional-vs.-modern clash, not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The Teapot Dome Scandal was straightforward political corruption — Harding administration officials taking bribes for naval oil leases. It was not a clash of traditional and modern culture, so it is the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The Scopes Monkey Trial (1925) pitted religious traditionalism against the modern science of evolution — a genuine culture clash, not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The Emergency Quota Act (1921) reflected nativist traditionalism pushing back against modern immigration from southern and eastern Europe — a genuine culture clash, not the exception.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch11-q09

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Which of the following was NOT a New Deal policy?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A Federal insurance for banks in order to ensure the confidence of depositors
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B Stricter laws against unionizing in order to prevent loss of income due to strikes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C Payments to farmers who agreed to substantially reduce production in order to stabilize prices
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D Government regulation of the stock market in order to protect investors
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Roosevelt adopted a pro-union stance regarding the New Deal, believing that the right to collective bargaining was critical to ensuring decent wages for workers. Americans would have more money to spend if they were adequately paid, and increased spending would benefit the economy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Federal deposit insurance was a New Deal policy: the FDIC (1933) insured bank deposits to restore depositor confidence — not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The New Deal was pro-union, not anti-union. Roosevelt backed collective bargaining (Wagner Act, 1935), so stricter laws against unionizing are the opposite of New Deal policy — this is the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: Paying farmers to cut production was a New Deal policy: the Agricultural Adjustment Act (1933) paid farmers to reduce output and stabilize prices — not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: Regulating the stock market was a New Deal policy: the Securities and Exchange Commission (1934) was created to protect investors — not the exception.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MCQpr25e-ch12-q05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Which of the following is true regarding leftist political groups in the 1960s?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. A Their leadership tended to be female dominated in keeping with feminist ideals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. B They were sharply divided in terms of those who supported the Vietnam War and those who opposed it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. C They were fiercely opposed to the Warren Court on ideological grounds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. D They caused a conservative backlash in the 1970s.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The radical leftist politics of the 1960s caused a conservative reaction in the 1970s, with the formation of many groups that advocated for a return to traditional American values on issues such as abortion, affirmative action, sexual morality, etc. However, leftist political groups in the 1960s were unified in their opposition to the Vietnam War and were ideologically aligned with the highly liberal Supreme Court under Earl Warren (although some believed the Court did not push the liberal agenda hard enough). While some groups took a strong feminist stance, most remained male-dominated, with women serving in supporting roles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A: Despite feminist rhetoric, most 1960s leftist groups remained male-dominated in their leadership.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • B: The 1960s left was unified in opposing the Vietnam War, not split between supporters and opponents of it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • C: The left was ideologically aligned with Earl Warren's liberal Supreme Court, not opposed to it — though some felt the Court did not go far enough.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • D: The radicalism of the 1960s provoked a conservative backlash in the 1970s, with new organizations pushing a return to traditional values on abortion, affirmative action, and sexual morality.
