                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      I do not say that democracy has been more pernicious on the whole, and in the long run, than monarchy or aristocracy. Democracy has never been and never can be so durable as aristocracy or monarchy; but while it lasts, it is more bloody than either.... Remember, democracy never lasts long. It soon wastes, exhausts, and murders itself. There never was a democracy yet that did not commit suicide. It is in vain to say that democracy is less vain, less proud, less selfish, less ambitious, or less avaricious than aristocracy or monarchy. It is not true, in fact, and nowhere appears in history. Those passions are the same in all men, under all forms of simple government, and when unchecked, produce the same effects of fraud, violence, and cruelty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A. Briefly explain John Adams's view of democracy as expressed in the excerpt. B. Briefly explain one development in the United States between 1800 and 1848 that reflects the concern Adams expresses. C. Briefly explain one development in the United States between 1800 and 1848 that challenges Adams's view that democracy destroys itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ["Adams argues that democracy is inherently unstable and self-destructive: it 'wastes, exhausts, and murders itself' because unchecked human passions for vanity, pride, and ambition produce fraud and violence in popular government.", "The bitter partisan conflict of the 1820s, including the 'corrupt bargain' controversy of 1824-1828 and the rise of scurrilous party newspapers, reflects his concern that democratic politics descends into factional strife.", 'The peaceful transfer of power in the election of 1800 and the expansion of suffrage to nearly all white men by the 1830s without the republic collapsing challenge his claim that democracy inevitably commits suicide.']

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ['The engraving suggests that early contact was cooperative and commercial, presenting Europeans and Native Americans as willing trading partners.', 'The hand-to-hand exchange of goods on the beach supports this, showing voluntary trade rather than conquest or coercion.', 'Participation in the fur trade drew Native societies into European market economies and rivalries, intensifying inter-tribal warfare over hunting grounds and access to European goods.']

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In Virginia, the Federalists campaigned for the administration with great energy after the Republicans attacked the Jay Treaty. According to an eyewitness, John Marshall led the effort, constantly warning of the horrors of war, and weeks of petitioning and public meetings culminated in resolutions demanding the treaty's execution. Although many New Yorkers backed the Republican demand for the treaty's negotiation papers, Republican agitation had not roused public opinion enough to drive the Federalists from power. The great groundswell came only after Washington entered the fray: the Republicans made a tragic blunder in letting the sanctity of Washington's name become a political football, which the Federalists were quick to exploit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A. Briefly explain one claim the author makes about the Federalists' defense of the Jay Treaty. B. Briefly explain one reason for the rise of political parties between 1789 and 1800 that is not discussed in the excerpt. C. Briefly explain one outcome for the Federalist Party after 1800.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ["Kurtz claims the Federalists won the battle over the Jay Treaty by rallying behind Washington's prestige; the Republicans blundered by attacking Washington's name, letting Federalists pose as defenders of national honor.", "Disagreement over Hamilton's financial program - the Bank, assumption of state debts, and tariffs - drove party formation, as Jefferson and Madison organized opposition to policies they saw as favoring elites.", 'After losing the election of 1800, the Federalists declined into a sectional New England party and effectively died after the Hartford Convention of 1814-1815 discredited them as disloyal.']

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Germany could not make the payments due on July 1, and without those payments America's own debtors, strained by the Depression, could hardly pay the United States. Financial collapse at this vulnerable point could drag down neighboring countries. Germany was not permanently ruined - Germans do not give up - so the nation had to be saved to take its place again as a safeguard against disorder. If Germany could not buy, prices of foodstuffs, cotton, and minerals would fall further; if revolution came, holders of German securities worldwide would suffer. Germany was the key spot: with her rescue, the tide might turn for everyone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ['President Hoover proposed the 1931 Hoover Moratorium, suspending war-debt and reparations payments for a year to stabilize European finances.', 'The Depression deepened American isolationism, leading Congress to pass the Neutrality Acts of the 1930s banning arms sales and loans to belligerents.', 'After 1945 the United States abandoned isolationism for sustained global engagement, building Cold War alliances such as NATO (1949) and funding European recovery through the Marshall Plan.']

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Democrats held many views but shared a commitment to the Jeffersonian ideal of an agrarian society. They saw the central government as the enemy of individual liberty and believed government intervention in the economy served special interests, creating corporate monopolies that favored the rich. They wanted to restore the independence of ordinary farmers and artisans by ending federal support for banks and corporations and by restricting paper currency, which they distrusted. Their view of government's proper role was mostly negative: reformers who wanted an active government to enact programs such as public education met Democratic opposition, since Democrats argued public schools violated parental responsibility and religious freedom.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A. Briefly explain one claim the author makes about the Democrats' view of government. B. Briefly explain one piece of evidence from 1800 to 1865 that supports the author's claim. C. Briefly explain one piece of evidence from 1800 to 1865 that challenges the author's claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ["Norton claims Democrats held a 'negative' view of government - seeing federal power as the enemy of liberty and opposing federal support for banks, corporations, and reforms like public schools.", "Jackson's 1832 veto of the Second Bank's recharter supports the claim, since he destroyed the national bank as a corrupt monopoly favoring the rich.", "Southern Democrats' aggressive use of federal power to protect slavery - such as the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850, which compelled northern officials to return escapees - challenges the claim that Democrats always opposed an active federal government."]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SAQsaq-test3-q2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Let me now take a more comprehensive view, and warn you in the most solemn manner against the baneful effects of the spirit of party generally. There is an opinion that parties in free countries are useful checks upon the administration of government, and serve to keep alive the spirit of liberty. This within certain limits is probably true; and in governments of a monarchical cast patriotism may look with indulgence, if not with favor, upon the spirit of party. But in those of the popular character, in governments purely elective, it is a spirit not to be encouraged.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A. Briefly explain one warning Washington gives in the excerpt. B. Briefly explain how the warning in the excerpt reflected one political debate of the 1790s. C. Briefly explain one development between 1800 and 1824 that tested Washington's warning about the spirit of party.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ['Washington warns that the spirit of party is especially dangerous in popular, elective governments and should not be encouraged.', "The warning reflects the fierce 1790s debate between Federalists and Democratic-Republicans over Hamilton's financial program and the French Revolution, which Washington feared would tear the young republic apart.", "The bitter election of 1800 and the partisan battles of Jefferson's presidency tested the warning, though the peaceful transfer of power showed the party system could function without destroying the republic."]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  SAQsaq-test3-q3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The portrait shows a prosperous colonial household: a formally dressed gentleman and his wife surrounded by their children in an elegant interior with fine furniture and drapery. The figures pose with composure and affection, projecting order, refinement, and domestic virtue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A. Briefly explain the point of view expressed in the portrait regarding social class in colonial America. B. Briefly explain how one element of the portrait expresses the point of view you identified in part A. C. Briefly explain how the point of view you identified in part A helped shape one significant development before 1800.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key: —

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ["The portrait expresses the gentry's view of itself as refined, orderly, and naturally suited to lead - displaying wealth and domestic virtue as marks of status.", "The fine clothing, elegant furniture, and composed poses advertise the family's gentility and distinguish them from laboring colonists.", "This elite self-image underpinned the Revolution's republican ideology of virtuous leadership, as colonial elites claimed the right to direct public affairs on the basis of their independence and refinement."]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test1-q05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Proponents of the theological ideas that were criticized by Williams in the excerpt believed that freedom to practice religion should be extended to

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A Puritans only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B all Protestants only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C all Christians only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D all Jews and Christians only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Believing that theirs was the one true church, the Puritans saw no contradiction in denying others the same rights they had sought in England.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: The Puritans believed theirs was the one true church and saw no contradiction in denying to others the toleration they had sought in England — religious freedom for Puritans only.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Too broad: Puritans persecuted fellow Protestants who dissented, including Quakers and Baptists like Williams himself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Far too broad: Puritans certainly did not extend religious freedom to all Christians — Catholics were excluded and dissenters punished.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Far too broad: the Puritans tolerated essentially only their own orthodoxy, not a general freedom for Jews and Christians.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test1-q06

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      An opponent of the ideas expressed by Williams would most likely have supported which of these political parties in the 1800s?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A The American (Know-Nothing) Party
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B The Free-Soil Party
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C The Democratic-Republican Party
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The Populist (People’s) Party
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      First, figure out what Williams’ claim is: that the church and state should largely be separate, and that the government should not be imposing a particular religion on its citizens. In the 1800s, only one of the four major political parties was interested in imposing a specific kind of religious conformity: the Know-Nothing Party, which wanted students reading Protestant Bibles in school and strong restrictions on Catholic immigration into America. For that reason, (A) is the best answer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: The Know-Nothing (American) Party wanted Protestant religious conformity — Protestant Bibles in public schools and sharp restrictions on Catholic immigration — making it the 1800s party most opposed to Williams's separation of church and state.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: The Free-Soil Party was organized around keeping slavery out of the western territories, not around imposing religious conformity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: The Democratic-Republicans, Jefferson's party, favored separating church and state (Jefferson authored Virginia's Statute for Religious Freedom) — aligned with Williams, not opposed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: The Populists were an agrarian economic-reform movement of the 1890s, not a religious-conformity party.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test1-q08

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A historian could use this source to show
