                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: The Pilgrims were Calvinists whose daily life followed Calvinist principles — they would support this view, so it is not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: The Pilgrims sought religious freedom for themselves, not for others. Their colonies were famously intolerant of dissent — banishing Roger Williams and Anne Hutchinson — so they would not support a society of religious freedom for all. This is the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: The Compact's 'civil body politic' founded on the signers' mutual covenant is government by consent of the governed — they would support this view, so it is not the exception.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test2-q03

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A continuity between the historical situation represented above and the First Great Awakening is that both were associated with

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A political activism in the early colonies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B philosophical enlightenment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C religious fervor
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D increased commercialization
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The First Great Awakening, a mid-18th-century wave of evangelical religious revival, saw a substantial return to the strong Calvinist doctrines of life and predeterminism. It saw a substantial return to the strong Calvinist doctrines of life and predeterminism. While political activism, (A), philosophical enlightenment, (B), and increased commercialization, (D), can be found at times throughout the colonies for much of this period, the First Great Awakening specifically pertains to this sudden and significant period of religious fervor in the colonies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Political activism is not the thread linking the 1620 Compact to the 1740s revivals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Philosophical enlightenment is not the link — the Awakening's emotional revivalism actually ran against cool rationalism.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Both were expressions of intense Protestant religious fervor: the Compact's godly mission to plant a Christian colony and the First Great Awakening's wave of revival and return to Calvinist doctrine.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Commercialization is not the thread connecting a 1620 religious covenant to an 18th-century revival.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • major · distractor_quality — distractor is too short to be plausible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • major · distractor_quality — distractor is too short to be plausible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test2-q05

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A historian could use this source to prove which of the following claims?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A American colonists had already begun shedding their English identities as early as the 1600s.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B Religious and civil authority tended to intermingle in some English colonies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C Religious freedom and tolerance were strong motivators for settlement in New England.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The majority of the original settlers of Plymouth were Puritans.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Because the colonists in this document pledge loyalty to their “dread sovereign Lord King James,” it’s unlikely they were shedding their English identities, so eliminate (A). While we tend to associate the Puritans with religious freedom, “tolerance” was not a value they particularly cared about, so eliminate (C). For (D), there is no evidence in the source that the majority of the Plymouth settlers were Puritans, only the ones who signed this document (there were non-Puritans on the Mayflower too), removing (D). Choice (B) makes sense because the document shows how religion and government tended to overlap for these groups.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: The signers pledge loyalty to their 'dread sovereign Lord King James,' so the document does not show colonists shedding English identity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: The Compact fuses a religious mission ('advancement of the Christian Faith') with civil government ('a civil body politic') — evidence that religious and civil authority intermingled in the colony.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: 'Tolerance' was not a Puritan value; they sought freedom for themselves while punishing dissent, so the source does not prove tolerance motivated settlement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: The source shows only that the signers were Puritans. Many Mayflower passengers ('Strangers') were not, so it cannot prove the majority were.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-test2-q09

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The revenue-generating measures imposed by the British in the mid-18th century were largely opposed by the colonists for all of the following reasons EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A a lack of representation in British Parliament
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B a perceived infringement upon the rights of the colonies to self-govern
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C a post-war economic depression was already limiting economic growth in the colonies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D a desire to declare independence from Great Britain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      During the mid-18th century (and even up to and during the Revolution), there remained a strong sense of loyalty toward the British. Very few at this time were calling for separation or independence, as hope remained for reform and greater representation in Parliament. The taxation and revenue-generating measures highlighted the lack of colonial representation in Parliament, (A), and interfered with the rights of the colonies to set their own taxes and self-govern, (B), both major points of contention among the colonies. In addition, the French and Indian War did lead to an economic depression, (C), which only exacerbated the impact of these new taxes and levies on the colonies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Lack of representation — 'no taxation without representation' — was a genuine colonial grievance, not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Perceived infringement on the colonies' right to tax themselves and self-govern was a genuine grievance, not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: A postwar economic depression squeezing colonial growth was a genuine grievance, not the exception.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: In the mid-1760s the colonists were still loyal Britons; very few wanted independence. They sought reform and representation within the empire, not separation — so this is the exception.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The policy adopted by the Jefferson administration in response to the situation above most contradicted which of the following characteristics of the Democratic-Republican Party?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A A commitment to reducing the size of the military
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B A belief in “strict construction” of the Constitution
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C A preference for the interests of yeoman farmers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D A skepticism of government taxes and tariffs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Jefferson did not raise taxes or tariffs to pay for the Louisiana Purchase, so eliminate (D). Jefferson also did manage to reduce the size of the military while in office, so (A) can be eliminated too. Jefferson’s Louisiana Purchase added a significant amount of farmland to the American state, something welcomed by yeoman farmers, so eliminate (C). Choose (B) because Jefferson’s purchase of Louisiana was criticized by opponents who argued that he lacked the constitutional authority to make the deal with France (but it was too good of a deal for him to pass up).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Jefferson did reduce the size of the military in office; the Louisiana Purchase did not contradict that commitment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Democratic-Republicans preached 'strict construction' — the federal government has only its listed powers. The Constitution says nothing about purchasing foreign territory, so Jefferson's sweeping purchase contradicted his own party's doctrine.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: The purchase added vast farmland, delighting yeoman farmers — consistent with, not contradictory to, Democratic-Republican values.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Jefferson did not raise taxes or tariffs to pay for Louisiana — consistent with the party's skepticism of taxation.
