                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQpr25e-ch07-q02

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The American colonists objected to the policies imposed by Parliament after the French and Indian War for all of the following reasons EXCEPT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A the new restrictions would hinder New England trade
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B their rights as Englishmen were being violated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C they resented quartering British troops now that the French threat was removed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D they wanted colonial representatives seated in Parliament in London
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      After the French and Indian War, colonists protested Parliament's taxes and trade restrictions, defended their rights as Englishmen, and resented quartering troops now that the French threat was gone. What they did not do was ask for seats in Parliament. Their argument was that Parliament had no authority to tax them at all — sending a few colonial delegates across the Atlantic would not have fixed what they saw as a violation of their rights.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Colonists did object on these grounds, so this is not the answer. New trade restrictions like the Sugar Act threatened New England merchants' livelihoods.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Colonists did object on these grounds, so this is not the answer. They argued that being taxed by a body in which they had no voice violated their rights as Englishmen.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Colonists did object on these grounds, so this is not the answer. With the French defeated, they saw no reason to house British soldiers in peacetime.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Correct — this is the EXCEPT. Colonists never demanded seats in Parliament; they argued Parliament lacked the authority to tax them entirely, and a handful of distant representatives would not have answered that objection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQbarrons-2027-pt2-32
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      "Did [this treaty] not . . . annex Louisiana, and squander millions in a week? . . . The American jacobin party, by rousing the popular passions, inevitably augments the powers of government, and contracts within narrower bounds . . . the privileges of the people. . . . What limits are there to the prerogatives of the present administration? . . . The Constitution, alas! that sleeps with Washington . . ." — Fisher Ames, Federalist congressman from Massachusetts, letter on the Louisiana Purchase treaty, 1803

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Ames's attack on 'the American jacobin party' identifies him with which of the following?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A The Whigs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B The Democratic-Republicans.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C The Anti-Federalists of the ratification era.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The Federalists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fisher Ames was a leading Federalist congressman from Massachusetts, and jacobin was the Federalists' insult for Thomas Jefferson's Democratic-Republicans, whom they painted as dangerous French-style radicals. Ames is attacking Jefferson's party for rousing popular passions and stretching executive power — classic Federalist rhetoric. The Louisiana Purchase, which he also denounces, was Jefferson's achievement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. The Whigs were a later party of the 1830s–1850s, formed in opposition to Andrew Jackson — not Ames's party in 1803.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Wrong. The Democratic-Republicans were the very party Ames is attacking as the American jacobin party.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Wrong. The Anti-Federalists opposed the Constitution in the 1780s; by 1803 Ames was defending strong national government, the opposite position.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Correct. Ames's attack on the jacobin party and his defense of constitutional limits identify him as a Federalist.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • major · distractor_quality — distractor is too short to be plausible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQbarrons-2027-ch06-09
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      "When the day of election approaches, visit your constituents far and wide. Treat liberally, and drink freely, in order to rise in their estimation.... Do all you can to appear to advantage in the eyes of the women.... kiss and slabber their children, wipe their noses, and pat them on the head.... Promise all that is asked... Offer to build a bridge or a church... Promises cost nothing.... Get up on all occasions... and make long-winded speeches.... Talk of your devotion to country, your modesty and disinterestedness.... Rail against taxes of all kinds, officeholders, and bad harvest weather." — Robert Penn Smith (as David Crockett), Colonel Crockett's Exploits and Adventures in Texas, 1837

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The style of campaigning satirized in the passage was made necessary primarily by which of the following?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A The rise of national party nominating conventions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B The elimination of property qualifications for voting, which vastly expanded the electorate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C The invention of the electric telegraph.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The introduction of federal funding for political campaigns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The satirized campaigning style — mass rallies, parades, slogans, and treating voters — belongs to the Jacksonian era, when states began dropping property requirements for voting. Suddenly hundreds of thousands of ordinary white men could vote, and candidates had to appeal to a mass electorate rather than a small circle of property holders. Popular campaigning became necessary because the voters candidates needed to persuade had enormously multiplied.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. National nominating conventions did develop in this era, but they organized party leadership; the mass campaign style was driven by the need to reach vastly more voters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Correct. Eliminating property qualifications hugely expanded the electorate, forcing candidates to campaign to the masses with rallies, slogans, and spectacle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Wrong. The telegraph (1840s) came later than the Jacksonian campaign revolution of the 1820s–1830s.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Wrong. Federal funding of campaigns did not exist in this era; campaigns were financed privately and by parties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings
