                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. Britain wanted manufacturing kept in England; the colonies were not supposed to make the goods England preferred to produce itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: True, but only part of the answer. Staple crops like tobacco were central, but so were raw materials.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: True, but only part of the answer. Raw materials like lumber were central, but so were staple crops.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Correct. The colonies' chief economic function was both: growing staple crops such as tobacco and supplying raw materials such as lumber.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQbarrons-2027-ch04-01
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Although some Puritan values resembled the rising capitalist ethic, Puritan economic life remained closer to the medieval than the modern. Unrestrained economic individualism would have alarmed any respectable Puritan. The statute books and court records of seventeenth-century Massachusetts are full of government-set price and wage controls. Puritans treated wealth as a trust from God, stressing duties and responsibilities alongside the benefits of work and gain. In 1639 the colony's General Court fined one of its richest merchants for excessive profiteering — though no statute prohibited the practice. The Puritans never separated religion from business and kept repeating the medieval idea of the 'just price.' Over the long run, though, once the Puritan work ethic was divorced from its religious setting, it quickened the spirit of capitalism: the old restraints on the individual gradually gave way to the enterprising, self-made figure who rose by his own exertions. — adapted from Gerald N. Grob and Robert N. Beck, American Ideas (1963)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What underlying Puritan belief made it possible for magistrates to fine the merchant in 1639 even though no statute authorized the penalty?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A Wealth was a trust from God carrying communal obligations, so norms of a 'just price' and 'just wage' could override the absence of written law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B Puritan courts held that magistrates could invent new laws whenever the colony's treasury ran short of funds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C The General Court believed wealthy merchants were secretly working as agents of the Anglican hierarchy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D Puritans held that English common law automatically permitted any penalty a magistrate chose to impose.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The Puritans believed wealth was a trust from God, carrying duties to the community alongside the right to profit. Their economy still followed the medieval idea of the just price — that prices and wages should be fair, not whatever the market would bear. That belief let the General Court punish excessive profiteering as a moral offense even with no statute on the books: the merchant had violated God's trust, and the magistrates enforced the community's moral norms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Correct. Puritans treated wealth as a divine trust with communal obligations, so just-price norms could justify punishment even without a written statute.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Wrong. The fine was not about filling the treasury; it enforced the Puritan moral economy against profiteering.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Wrong. There is no evidence the merchant was accused of serving the Anglican hierarchy; the issue was excessive profit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Wrong. Puritans did not believe magistrates could impose any penalty at will; the fine rested on shared religious norms about fair dealing, not arbitrary power.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQ5s24-ch07-mcq-01

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Which European colonists maintained the most cooperative relations with Native Americans?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A The Spanish
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B The Dutch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C The French
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The English
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The French came to North America mainly for the fur trade, which required Native cooperation — French traders lived among Native peoples, learned their languages, and forged alliances through trade and intermarriage. Unlike the Spanish encomienda system or English settler expansion that displaced tribes, the French economic model depended on partnership. That dependence produced the most cooperative — though still unequal and self-interested — relationship of any European colonists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. Spanish relations were defined by conquest, forced labor, and missionary coercion — not cooperation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Wrong. The Dutch had limited, mostly commercial contact centered on New Netherland and did not build the broad alliances the French did.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Correct. The French fur trade depended on Native partners, producing the most cooperative relations of any European colonists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Wrong. English settler colonies expanded onto Native lands, producing repeated displacement and warfare.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQ5s24-ch03-mcq-21
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Questions 21–24 refer to the following quotation. "At last they brought him to Werowocomoco, where was Powhatan, their emperor. Here more than two hundred of those grim courtiers stood wondering at him..." —Captain John Smith, on his capture, 1608 (abridged)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Smith's description of Powhatan as an 'emperor' surrounded by 'courtiers' most directly reveals that

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A Powhatan had studied European government
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B Smith was fluent in Algonquian languages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C Smith imposed European political categories on a Native society
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D The English recognized Powhatan sovereignty as fully equal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Powhatan led a powerful Algonquian chiefdom, but emperor and courtiers are European court vocabulary — titles from a world of kings and palaces. Smith reached for the only political language he knew, dressing a Native leader in the costume of European monarchy. The description tells us more about Smith's mental framework than about how Powhatan's society actually governed itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. There is no evidence Powhatan studied European government; the European terms are Smith's, not Powhatan's.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Wrong. The passage shows Smith using English political vocabulary, not demonstrating fluency in Algonquian.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Correct. Smith imposed European political categories — emperor, courtiers — on a Native society organized on entirely different terms.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Wrong. Using royal titles did not mean the English accepted Powhatan as a sovereign equal; they soon moved to dominate his people.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      QA findings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MCQ5s24-exam1-mcq-14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Questions 13–16 refer to the following excerpt. "I appeal to any white man to say if ever he entered Logan's cabin hungry and he gave him not meat... During the course of the last long and bloody war Logan remained idle in his cabin, an advocate for peace... I had even thought to have lived with you but for the injuries of one man. Colonel Cresap, the last spring, in cold blood and unprovoked, murdered all the relations of Logan... There runs not a drop of my blood in the veins of any living creature. This called on me for revenge. I have sought it. I have killed many... But do not harbor a thought that mine is the joy of fear. Logan never felt fear." —Logan (Tah-gah-jute), speech recorded 1774 (abridged)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The speech was delivered in the context of

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. A Pontiac's Rebellion against British rule in the Great Lakes region
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. B King Philip's War between colonists and Native peoples in New England
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. C Bacon's Rebellion against Virginia's colonial government in 1676
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. D Lord Dunmore's War and escalating settler–Native conflict in the Ohio Valley
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Answer and explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key: D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Logan's speech — recorded in 1774 — mourns his family murdered by Colonel Cresap's men and vows revenge. The context is Lord Dunmore's War: Virginia settlers pushing into the Ohio Valley, Cresap's unprovoked killings, and the cycle of retaliation that followed. Logan, a Mingo leader who had advocated peace, took up the hatchet only after his kin were slaughtered in cold blood.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A: Wrong. Pontiac's Rebellion (1763) was a Great Lakes uprising a decade earlier, not the 1774 Ohio Valley conflict Logan describes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • B: Wrong. King Philip's War (1675–1676) was fought in New England, a century's distance from Logan's Ohio country.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C: Wrong. Bacon's Rebellion (1676) was Virginians rebelling against their own governor, not Logan's war of revenge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • D: Correct. The speech belongs to Lord Dunmore's War and the escalating settler-Native violence in the Ohio Valley in 1774.
